item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 23/Apr/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the persistent influence of a trough of low pressure, the weather will be unsettled with heavy showers and squally thunderstorms over southern China for the rest of this week.

Date/Month: 24/04 (Wednesday)
Wind: South to southeast force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with occasional showers and thunderstorms.
Temp range: 24 - 28 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium

Date/Month: 25/04 (Thursday)
Wind: South to southeast force 3 to 4.
Weather: Cloudy with occasional showers and squally thunderstorms. Showers will be heavier at times.
Temp range: 25 - 28 C

PSR: High
